text: DSH Diff Review Likecodex 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 添加文件差异审阅。它汇总当前对话轮次中 agent 产生的文件，并在侧栏展示差异；支持 split 或 unified 布局、长行换行、行级评论，以及对完整记录的文本变更执行撤销或重做。Better Sidebar 可选，未启用时使用原生右侧栏。插件使用 DSH Host 远程服务和 Web UI，无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Diff Review Likecodex reviews file changes in DeepSeek Harness Web. It groups changed files by turn and shows diffs in a sidebar. Reviewers can comment on changed lines and undo or redo complete recorded changes. It supports split or unified layouts. Better Sidebar is optional.

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Repository and namespace：The plugin owns the `diffReviewLikecodex` remote/service namespace, `diff-review-likecodex` settings/locale namespace, `dshDiffReviewLikecodex` marker property, and `diff-review-likecodex.deliverables` turn data key. Its UI/plugin registration IDs use the `dsh-diff-review-likecodex:` prefix. Public DSH slots retain their framework names; this plugin does not register the shared `chatFileMentions` service, avoiding conflicts with other plugins.

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Repository and namespace：Historical compatibility markers are read-only compatibility data, used only when no plugin marker is present. The Host neither consumes legacy markers as its own nor deletes or rewrites them. New comments use `<diff_review_likecodex_comments>`; historical `<file_review_comments>` messages remain displayable without writing legacy services or settings. The Cordis patch only inserts this plugin and does not disable DSH's built-in deliverables plugin.

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Acknowledgements and upstream origin：This project is an independently maintained fork derived from [left0ver](https://github.com/left0ver)'s [dsh-file-review](https://github.com/left0ver/dsh-file-review) repository. We express sincere gratitude to the original author for the initial concept and open-source foundation.

   - Retained and enhanced the native right sidebar review tabs and message-tail review shortcuts.

💬 Chat  →  ✨ Generate  →  📄 Click a changed file  →  🔍 Review

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Features：1. This plugin supports standard, PTC, and Creator modes, but **does not currently support Minimal mode**.
2. Review every file the agent just changed in the `Diff` panel.
3. Undo edited and newly created files. Deleted-file reversal requires a tool that supplies a supported, captured lifecycle change.
4. Add comments to changed lines and ask the agent to continue making updates based on the feedback, or ask questions about the changes.
5. Automatically wrap long text while reviewing. Enable it under Settings → Plugins → Plugin configuration → Diff Review Likecodex; it is disabled by default.
6. Multilingual support, including Chinese and English.
7. A compact, content-sized review bar appears above the composer while a turn is running and disappears on completion or stop; the final card always shows all files.
8. Absolute/relative aliases for the same workspace file are combined without double-counting; same-named files in different directories show their directory for disambiguation.
9. Newly captured diffs retain three real context lines before and after changes; missing historical context is never fabricated from current files.
10. Op

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Compatibility：See the badge above for the currently supported DSH CLI version. `dsh-better-sidebar` is an optional peer dependency (`>=0.19.1 <0.20`), not a required browser injection; the native sidebar remains the fallback. Furthermore, the running compact floating bar and quick review entry architecture are cleanly decoupled and can be merged directly into the `bettersider` (`dsh-better-sidebar`) project for deeper integrated sidebar workflow synergy.

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Install from local source：Run these commands in your existing checkout of this fork. No clone URL is provided because the fork's repository is not yet known. Installation and deployment are separate actions; reviewing or building this source does not install it.

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run build
dsh plugin --profile web add ${PWD}
```

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Package installation after publication：Only after you have independently confirmed publication of this exact fork package, use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-diff-review-likecodex
```

Recent `pnpm` versions may enforce a minimum release age. If needed, add the fork's exact package name to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
minimumReleaseAgeExclude:
  - dsh-diff-review-likecodex
```

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Update the plugin：For a package-based installation, after confirming the target release:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-diff-review-likecodex
```

dsh-diff-review-likecodex README · Uninstall the plugin：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-diff-review-likecodex
```
